newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-BJORN NAMED EUROPEAN ROOKIE OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BJORN NAMED EUROPEAN ROOKIE OF YEAR.

text.p: Thomas Bjorn, who became the first Danish golfer to win on the European Tour when he captured the Loch Lomond World Invitational in September, has won the Sir Henry Cotton Rookie of the Year award.

Bjorn finished 10th on the Order of Merit, the highest placing by a Tour debutant since Jose Maria Olazabal was second to Seve Ballesteros in his first season in 1986. He also enters 1997 second to Colin Montgomerie on the Ryder Cup qualifying points table.
